entries:
How is your Pokédex coming along?
Can I see it?

If you want to meet more Pokémon, you
should try walking through tall grass!{VAR BE01}

It seems a little more like a Pokédex now!
You're getting off to a good start!{VAR BE01}

Some Pokémon are hard to find, but don't
give up! Keep checking the tall grass.{VAR BE01}

That is an excellent Pokédex!
Just a little more and it will be full!{VAR BE01}

It seems like you are meeting Pokémon at
a good clip!{VAR BE01}
I have something I want to give you!
Please come to the lab when you can.
Try using this, too!{VAR BE01}
Keep up the good work!

Trading Pokémon with friends also
counts as catching them!{VAR BE01}

This is a very thorough Pokédex.
It will help my research, too!{VAR BE01}

So you're here to show me how your
Pokédex is coming along, right?

I see!{VAR BE01}
You've caught {VAR 0202 0000} Pokémon, then...

Nationally, there are more than
600 Pokémon!{VAR BE01}
You'll have to be persistent and
catch them at your own pace.

First, you might want to revisit places
you've already been.{VAR BE01}
Retrace your steps in the Unova region
and see what new Pokémon turn up!

Remember Rule No. 1! To catch a Pokémon,
you first have to reduce its HP.{VAR BE01}
You're pretty good at this now,
but don't forget the basics!

You've caught more than 400
different Pokémon?!{VAR BE01}
That's incredible!
You're an amazing Trainer!

Have you been to the Poké Transfer Lab
on Route 15?{VAR BE01}
Mastering a facility like that is an
accomplishment for a Pokémon Trainer.

Just a little more until you complete
your Pokédex, huh?{VAR BE01}
Catching this many Pokémon must mean...
You really like Pokémon, don't you!
